description_en: Queries a list of data protection rules
description_zh: 查询数据保护规则列表
name: DescribeRules

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Valid values: If NextToken is empty, no next query exists. If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。                                 如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为50。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The resource category ID. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple resource category IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源分类 ID。过滤指定资源分类的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个资源分类 ID
parameters.name: resource_category_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified region. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple region IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源所在地域 ID。过滤指定地域的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个地域 ID
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned
parameters.help_zh: 资源所有者 ID 列表，在跨账号统一管理中使用。过滤指定账号的资源计算结果，不填则获取当前登录账号的数据
parameters.name: resource_owner_ids
